text: Yes, the 2022 loss was detected with Sentinel-2 imagery. The Hansen GFC data (which uses Sentinel-2) confirmed tree-cover loss of about 0.6 hectares within the asset in 2022. This was corroborated by the JRC GFC2020 reference map, which agreed on the full event area. The loss was observed in a native forest context, and the detection meets the minimum event area threshold of 0.5 hectares.
